svg.text: ZONE-1 ANODE (gyroid — envelope card)
Деталь 1 — buried EBFC anode · anchor_zone1_pine · 01_01 §5 · coating map 01_02 §3.6
SECTION A–A
Ø1 bus rod (SOLID, monolithic §1.4)
gyroid lattice annulus — SPEC, not drawn
⚠ coating zone boundary: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM — see COATING note
SIDE (envelope)
NOTES:
1. Envelope & lattice parameters (from this manifest's own fields): gyroid, topology network; cell period 2.5→2 mm core→rim; wall param 0.1
constant (dimensionless, topology-coupled — NOT mm); print floor 0.2 mm [canon default 01_01 §5.5]. Porosity TARGET 65 % — this is the
generator's goal, NOT the acceptance band; the band and its verdict are in the Lattice note below.
2. Coating zone boundary: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM. 01_02 §3.6 gives Zone 1 TWO rows with opposite permissions (gyroid wall in xylem sap ⊥
periphery in callus contact); the dividing surface is not a field of this manifest and is NOT derivable from the geometry on this sheet.
Query it before applying any coating — do not infer it.
3. Material: V-free Ti alloy (01_02 2.5, founder 2026-06-21) - the SPECIFIC alloy is NOT selected until the Stage-2 coin bake-off (00_07
HW.24); Ti-6Al-4V is the price and print baseline only, NOT the material of this part
4. Process: SLM/LPBF MANDATORY for Zone 1 - NOT EBM, and the powder fraction is the reason: 15-45 um resolves the lattice where EBM 45-105
um risks plugging fine pores (01_02 1.7) | HIP obligatory 920C/100-150 MPa Ar/2-4 h, then vacuum anneal 800C/2 h (01_02 1.3 Step 2, 1.7)
| build direction PARALLEL to the long axis, 0 +/-5 deg, externally-only supports (01_02 1.6) | de-powdering is CHEMICAL: vacuum
decanting + citric/Tween circulation (1.3 Step 3). NO Al2O3 sand-blasting and NO static-tank etching on this part - both are
canon-forbidden for Zone 1 specifically, unlike the Zone-3 flange (01_02 1.3a Failure Modes A and B)
5. Surface: EAAE dual-scale on the gyroid walls: micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm, BET area >10x a smooth sample (01_02 1.2). NO PEP
smoothing on this part - the plasma sheath is Faraday-caged in sub-500 um channels and PEP belongs to the Zone-3 outer jacket only (01_02
1.3 Step 7)
6. Post-process: EAAE with forced flow-through + ultrasonic cavitation (01_02 1.3 Step 4), then dehydrogenation bake 250C/10-3 mbar/3h
within 2h of rinse - MANDATORY, and HIP does NOT substitute for it: hydrogen enters AFTER HIP, at the EAAE stage (01_02 1.3a Failure Mode
C). LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per batch or the batch is rejected
7. Coating: Gyroid walls in xylem-sap contact (the anode active surface): ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) ALL
FORBIDDEN - any dielectric blocks DET, and canon forbids ZnO-Ta on Zone-1 gyroid walls outright (01_02 3.6). Bare Ti with the dual-scale
roughness only; the Gen 2.0 bio-electrochemical stack is applied by us downstream, cold (01_03 2.1). The Zone-1 PERIPHERY in callus
contact, carrying no immobilised enzymes, is a DIFFERENT row of the same map (Zn-HAp + chitosan allowed, ZnO-Ta only outside the enzyme
zone - 01_02 3.6, 01_04 4). WHERE that boundary runs is STILL not a field of this manifest and is not derivable from the geometry. Since
2026-09-11 it has a CARRIER but not an ANSWER: draw anchor_zone1 renders the refusal on the sheet itself - a leader pointing at the rim
plus its own NOTES line - so the shop is handed the question instead of a silent default. Query it before applying anything; do not infer
it from the geometry (00_07 HW.1)
8. Lattice: Gyroid, NETWORK topology (ratified founder 2026-09-10, 00_07 HW.33) - ONE through pore labyrinth by construction. Cell period is
graded core->rim by this manifest's own fields; read them, not prose. Porosity: canon carries THREE numbers and they are not
interchangeable - nominal 65% (01_01 5.2), verification 65 +/-2% (01_01 5.6), factory acceptance band 60-70% (01_02 1.2). How they relate
is an OPEN verdict (00_07 HW.33), so all three are quoted and none is dropped. Verify by Archimedes open porosity + uCT connectivity
9. Inspect: SEM before shipment at x500 (gyroid macro-pores), x5,000 (micro-roughness: report the AREAL Sa of the 01_02 1.2 acceptance row,
not a profile Ra) and x50,000 (nano-pores Sv) - all three frames apply to THIS part because it has the macro-pore geometry the x500 frame
is for; if nano-pores are not visible at x50,000 the etch is insufficient and EAAE is repeated (01_02 1.5). uCT pore-gradient
verification in the PRINTED range (targets set by 00_07 HW.33, not by this line). Archimedes open porosity. LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per
batch or rejected. ICP-MS of the rinse water, Al<1 ppb - confirms no corundum residue (01_02 1.2, 1.5)
10. Zone 1 = the buried anode: gyroid walls in xylem sap (01_01 1)
11. The monolithic bus rod (01_01 1.4) is this part's own solid core when bus_rod_diameter_mm > 0; it is SDF-invisible, so the porosity and
connectivity gates measure the gyroid annulus, not the rod
12. slm_min_wall_mm is a VENDOR input (ratified 2026-09-10): absent means the canon 200 um default of 01_01 5.5 (a DEFAULT, not a constant -
and a different quantity from the 0.3 mm gyroid wall floor of 01_02 1.7), and the same number also sets the measurement grid - a finer
vendor floor costs about an order of magnitude more run time
13. The factory sheet EXISTS since 2026-09-11 (draw anchor_zone1 -> SVG + DXF, 00_07 HW.1): these notes are both the SOURCE of the
acceptance contract and, through that generator, its CARRIER. Re-run draw after editing any note - nothing re-runs the published gallery
for you
14. The envelope O is the MALE half of the Zone1<->Zone2 press-fit, and its diametral band on the tolerance block is deliberately BLANK
rather than absent: canon 01_01 4.2 requires those micrometres to come from the Lame interference window (E_PEEK-aware) and explicitly
NOT from a blind ISO 286 H7/s6 lookup, and that window has not been solved into a band (00_07 HW.3). Quote your achievable as-printed
band rather than reading a default into the blank
